40019643.author: पदार्थः
40019643.content: सत्यविक्रमः truthful prowess, परवीरहा destroyer of enemies, भरतः Bharata, परमानन्दम् very happy, श्रुत्वा hearingतु you, हृष्टम् delightful, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, आज्ञापयामास ordered

40019643.author: Translation
40019643.content: Hearing the delightful news, Bharata of truthful prowess, the destroyer of enemies, was very happy and ordered Shatrughna.

40019644.author: पदार्थः
40019644.content: सर्वाणि all, दैवतानि gods, नगरस्य in the capital, चैत्यानि च temples, शुचयः purifying, नराः people, सुगन्धमाल्यैः with fragrance and garlands, वादित्रैः musical instruments अर्चन्तु worship

40019644.author: Translation
40019644.content: "Let all gods in the temples of the capital be worshiped by people purifying themselves, duly adorned with fragrance and garlands."

40019645.author: पदार्थः
40019645.content: स्तुतिपुराणज्ञाः bards well versed in singing, सूताः charioteers, तथा so also, सर्वे all, वैताळिकाः courtesans, सर्वे all, वादित्रकुशलाः experts in playing musical instruments, सङ्घशः, in groups गणिकाः traders, राजदाराः royal, तथा similarly, अमात्याः ministers, सैन्याः army, सेवाङ्गनागणाः service providers, सराजन्याः kshatriyas, ब्राह्मणाश्च brahmins, श्रेणीमुख्याः top people, तथा so also, गणाः troops, रामस्य Rama's, शशिनिभम् moon like countenance, मुखम् face, द्रष्टुम् to see, अभिनिर्यान्तु will proceed

40019645.author: Translation
40019645.content: "Let the bards well versed in singing praises, charioteers, all courtesans, in groups, artists who can play musical instruments, similarly ministers, army men, traders, service providers, Kshatriyas, brahmins so also top people, troops proceed to see the moon like face of Rama."

40019646.author: पदार्थः
40019646.content: स्तुतिपुराणज्ञाः bards well versed in singing, सूताः charioteers, तथा so also, सर्वे all, वैताळिकाः courtesans, सर्वे all, वादित्रकुशलाः experts in playing musical instruments, सङ्घशः, in groups गणिकाः traders, राजदाराः royal, तथा similarly, अमात्याः ministers, सैन्याः army, सेवाङ्गनागणाः service providers, सराजन्याः kshatriyas, ब्राह्मणाश्च brahmins, श्रेणीमुख्याः top people, तथा so also, गणाः troops, रामस्य Rama's, शशिनिभम् moon like countenance, मुखम् face, द्रष्टुम् to see, अभिनिर्यान्तु will proceed

40019646.author: Translation
40019646.content: "Let the bards well versed in singing praises, charioteers, all courtesans, in groups, artists who can play musical instruments, similarly ministers, army men, traders, service providers, Kshatriyas, brahmins so also top people, troops proceed to see the moon like face of Rama."

40019647.author: पदार्थः
40019647.content: परवीरहा destroyer of enemies, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, भरतस्य Bharata's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, अनेकसाहस्रीः many courageous, विष्टीः labour, भागशः divisions, चोदयामास be also called

40019647.author: Translation
40019647.content: Shatrughna, a destroyer of enemies, hearing the words of Bharata, ordered for many divisions of labour and the courageous ones to come.

40019648.author: पदार्थः
40019648.content: इतः from here, नन्दिग्रामात् from Nandigrama, परम् very, निम्नानि low lying, समीकुरुत equal, विषमाणि uneven, समानि च level, स्थानानि areas, निरस्यन्ताम् remove them.

40019648.author: Translation
40019648.content: From here (Nandigrama to Ayodhya) low lying areas are to be made even and uneven areas to be levelled.

40019649.author: पदार्थः
40019649.content: कृत्स्नाम् in the ground, पृथिवीम् soil, हिमशीतेव with cold water, वारिणा water, सिञ्चस्तु sprinkle small drops, ततः then, अन्ये other, सर्वतः all over, लाजैः parched grain, पुष्पैश्च flowers, अभ्यवकिरन्तु strew

40019649.author: Translation
40019649.content: Let the ground be sprinkled with cold water and then parched grain and flowers to be sprinkled.

40019650.author: पदार्थः
40019650.content: पुरवरोत्तमे best of the foremost cities, रथ्याः streets, समुच्छ्रितपताकाः with flags, सूर्यस्य sun's, उदयनंप्रति till the rise, वेश्मानि houses, शोभयन्तु decorate.

40019650.author: Translation
40019650.content: Let the streets of the foremost of the best cities (Ayodhya), be decorated with flags till the sun rises and houses be decorated.

40019651.author: पदार्थः
40019651.content: शतशः hundreds, नराः people, सुगन्धैः fragrant, पञ्चवर्णकैः five colours, स्रग्दाममुक्तपुष्पैश्च garlands of fragrant flowers, असम्बाधम् closely, राजमार्गम् royal paths, किरन्तु decorate.

40019651.author: Translation
40019651.content: Let hundreds of people decorate with fragrant garlands of five colours closely tied and decorate the royal paths.

40019652.author: पदार्थः
40019652.content: ततः then, शत्रुघ्नस्य Shatrughna's, तत् that, शासनम् command, श्रुत्वा hearing, मुदा joy अन्विताः great, धृष्टिः Dhristi, जयन्तः Jayanta, विजयःVijaya, सिद्धार्थश्च Siddhartha, अर्थसाधकः Arthasadhaka, अशोकः Ashoka, मन्त्रपालश्च Mantrapala, समन्त्रश्चापि all over, निर्ययुः issued forth.

40019652.author: Translation
40019652.content: On hearing Shatrughna's command, all the eight ministers, Dhristi, Jayanta, Vijaya, Siddhartha, Arthasadhaka, Ashoka, and Mantrapala issued forth with great joy.

40019653.author: पदार्थः
40019653.content: ततः then, शत्रुघ्नस्य Shatrughna's, तत् that, शासनम् command, श्रुत्वा hearing, मुदा joy अन्विताः great, धृष्टिः Dhristi, जयन्तः Jayanta, विजयःVijaya, सिद्धार्थश्च Siddhartha, अर्थसाधकः Arthasadhaka, अशोकः Ashoka, मन्त्रपालश्च Mantrapala, समन्त्रश्चापि all over, निर्ययुः issued forth.

40019653.author: Translation
40019653.content: On hearing Shatrughna's command, all the eight ministers, Dhristi, Jayanta, Vijaya, Siddhartha, Arthasadhaka, Ashoka, and Mantrapala issued forth with great joy.

40019654.author: पदार्थः
40019654.content: मत्स्सैः elephants in rut, सध्वजैः best horses, सुविभूषितैः well decorated, नागसहस्रैः thousand elephants, अपरेतु on the top, हेमकक्षाभिः golden girths on waist, सगजाभिः those elephants, करेणुभिः female elephants also, सुमहारथाः best charioteers, रथैश्च chariots, निर्ययुः proceeded.

40019654.author: Translation
40019654.content: Seated on top of thousands of well decorated elephants in rut, and on the best of horses, people went (to receive Rama). Female elephants had golden girths on their waist. Best charioteers on best chariots proceeded.

40019655.author: पदार्थः
40019655.content: तुरगाणाम् horses, मुख्यैः chiefs, मुख्यतरान्वितैः champions, सहस्रैः in thousands, परिवृताः surrounded, वीराः heroes, ययुःwent, क्त्यृष्टिपाशहस्तानां with javelins, spears and nooses, सध्वजानां people, पताकिनाम् carrying flags, पदातीनां on foot, वीराः heroes,

40019655.author: Translation
40019655.content: Chiefs on horses, champions in thousands went surrounded by thousands of foot soldiers carrying javelins, spears, and nooses.

40019656.author: पदार्थः
40019656.content: तुरगाणाम् horses, मुख्यैः chiefs, मुख्यतरान्वितैः champions, सहस्रैः in thousands, परिवृताः surrounded, वीराः heroes, ययुःwent, क्त्यृष्टिपाशहस्तानां with javelins, spears and nooses, सध्वजानां people, पताकिनाम् carrying flags, पदातीनां on foot, वीराः heroes,

40019656.author: Translation
40019656.content: Chiefs on horses, champions in thousands went surrounded by thousands of foot soldiers carrying javelins, spears, and nooses.

40019657.author: पदार्थः
40019657.content: ततः then, सर्वाःall, दशरथस्त्रियः women of Dasharatha, यानानि palanquins, उपारूढाः seated, कौसल्याम् Kausalya, सुमित्रांचापि Sumitra, प्रमुखेकृत्वा keeping in front, निर्ययुः started, सर्वाः all, कैकेय्या Kaikeyi, सहिताः accompanied by, नन्दिग्रामम् Nandigrama, उपाययुः went

40019657.author: Translation
40019657.content: Then all the consorts of Dasharatha, keeping Kausalya and Sumitra in front, seated in palanquin accompanied by Kaikeyi, started from Nandigram.

40019658.author: पदार्थः
40019658.content: द्विजातिमुख्यैः foremost of brahmins, सनैगमैः together, श्रेणीमुख्यैश्च foremost leaders, माल्यमोदकहस्तै: having garlands and Modakas (kind of sweet which is white in colour) in hand, मन्त्रिभिः ministers also, वृतः surrounded, धर्मात्मा righteous, शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्च with sounds of conches and drums, वन्दिभिश्च with bards praising, अभिनन्तितः greeting, धर्मकोविदः knowledgeable of responsibilities, उपवासकृशः emaciated by fasting, दीनः desperate, चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरः wearing bark clothes and a skin of antelope, भ्रातुः brother, आगमनम् returning, श्रुत्वा hearing, तत्पूर्वम् before that, हर्षम् joy, आगतः experienced, महात्मा great soul, भरतः Bharata, आर्यपादौ sandals of noble Rama, शिरसा on head, गृहीत्वा taking, शुक्लमाल्योपशोभितम् decorated with white garlands, पाण्डुरम् yellow, छत्रम् umbrella, राजार्हे worthy of kings, हेमभूषिते adorned with gold, शुक्ले white, वालव्यजने whisks, आदाय taking, सचिवैःसह with friends, तदा then, प्रत्युद्ययौ went to receive

40019658.author: Translation
40019658.content: Then the foremost of brahmins, leaders with garlands and Modaka sweets in hand, surrounded by ministers went with righteous Bharata, accompanied by bards praising, accompanied by sounds of blowing conches and drums and greeting. Bharata was emaciated due to fastings, was desperate, wearing bark fabric and skin of antelope. The great soul Bharata, knower of righteous responsibilities, greeting, experienced great joy, on hearing about the returning of the brother. Decorated with white garlands, he carried Rama's sandals on his head. His friends accompanied him and took with him a yellow umbrella adorned with gold, worthy of kings and white whisks. Bharata went to receive Sri Rama.

40019659.content: द्विजातिमुख्यैः foremost of brahmins, सनैगमैः together, श्रेणीमुख्यैश्च foremost leaders, माल्यमोदकहस्तै: having garlands and Modakas (kind of sweet which is white in colour) in hand, मन्त्रिभिः ministers also, वृतः surrounded, धर्मात्मा righteous, शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्च with sounds of conches and drums, वन्दिभिश्च with bards praising, अभिनन्तितः greeting, धर्मकोविदः knowledgeable of responsibilities, उपवासकृशः emaciated by fasting, दीनः desperate, चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरः wearing bark clothes and a skin of antelope, भ्रातुः brother, आगमनम् returning, श्रुत्वा hearing, तत्पूर्वम् before that, हर्षम् joy, आगतः experienced, महात्मा great soul, भरतः Bharata, आर्यपादौ sandals of noble Rama, शिरसा on head, गृहीत्वा taking, शुक्लमाल्योपशोभितम् decorated with white garlands, पाण्डुरम् yellow, छत्रम् umbrella, राजार्हे worthy of kings, हेमभूषिते adorned with gold, शुक्ले white, वालव्यजने whisks, आदाय taking, सचिवैःसह with friends, तदा then, प्रत्युद्ययौ went to receive

40019663.author: पदार्थः
40019663.content: अश्वानाम् of the horses, खुरशब्देन by the sounds hoofs, रथनेमिस्वनेनच rattling of the chariots, शङ्खदुन्दुभिघोषेण by the sounds of drums and conches, मेदिनी earth, सञ्चचालेव shook

40019663.author: Translation
40019663.content: The earth shook by the sounds of hooves of the horses, sounds of conches and drums, and the rattling of the chariot wheels.

40019664.author: पदार्थः
40019664.content: तत् then, कृत्स्नम् dark, नगरम् city, नन्दिग्रामम् Nandigramam, उपागमत् reached, भरतः Bharata, समीक्ष्य reviewed, पवनात्मजम् with wind god's son, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke

40019664.author: Translation
40019664.content: Reviewing the arrangements, Bharata spoke these words to wind god's son, Hanuman.

40019665.author: पदार्थः
40019665.content: कापेयी O monkey, चलचित्तता fickle minded, न सेव्यतेखलु not resorted, कच्चित् indeed, काकुत्स्थम् Kakuthsa, परन्तपम् tormentor of enemies, आर्यम् noble, रामम् Rama, न पश्यामिहि not see

40019665.author: Translation
40019665.content: "O monkey! Indeed, you monkey being fickle minded, hope you have not resorted to your nature. I am not seeing noble Rama, the tormentor of enemies."

40019666.author: पदार्थः
40019666.content: अथ and then, एवम् in that way, वचने words, उक्ते spoken, हनूमान् by Hanuman, सत्यविक्रमम् righteous, भरतम् Bharata, विज्ञापयन्नेव knowing, अर्थ्यम् meaning, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke

40019666.author: Translation
40019666.content: And then Bharata having spoken that way, Hanuman understood the meaning of his words and spoke thus.

40019667.author: पदार्थः
40019667.content: भरद्वाजप्रसादेन grace of Bharadwaja, सदाफलान् fruits all through, कुसुमितान् flowers, मधुस्रवान् shedding sweet juice, मत्तभ्रमरनादितान् noisy by the noisy bees, वृक्षान् trees, प्राप्य seen, प्रहृष्टानाम् very delighted, वनौकसाम् forest rangers, भीमः terrific, निःस्वनः sounds, श्रूयते is heard, परन्तप tormentor of enemies, तस्य his, एषः in that way, वरः boon, वासवेन, दत्तः given by Indra, ससैन्यस्य that army, तव your, सर्वगुणान्वितम् endowed with all virtues, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, कृतम् done, सा they, वानरसेना Vanara army, गोमतींनदीम् Gomathi, तरति crossing, मन्ये I think

40019667.author: Translation
40019667.content: "By the grace of Bharadwaja, all the trees have fruits shedding sweet juice, and in bloom, the Vanaras are very delighted. The forest rangers are making terrific sounds. The tormentor of enemies, endowed with all virtues, by virtue of the boon given by Indra extended hospitality to the Vanara army. I think they are crossing the river Gomathi now."

40019668.author: पदार्थः
40019668.content: भरद्वाजप्रसादेन grace of Bharadwaja, सदाफलान् fruits all through, कुसुमितान् flowers, मधुस्रवान् shedding sweet juice, मत्तभ्रमरनादितान् noisy by the noisy bees, वृक्षान् trees, प्राप्य seen, प्रहृष्टानाम् very delighted, वनौकसाम् forest rangers, भीमः terrific, निःस्वनः sounds, श्रूयते is heard, परन्तप tormentor of enemies, तस्य his, एषः in that way, वरः boon, वासवेन, दत्तः given by Indra, ससैन्यस्य that army, तव your, सर्वगुणान्वितम् endowed with all virtues, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, कृतम् done, सा they, वानरसेना Vanara army, गोमतींनदीम् Gomathi, तरति crossing, मन्ये I think

40019668.author: Translation
40019668.content: "By the grace of Bharadwaja, all the trees have fruits shedding sweet juice, and in bloom, the Vanaras are very delighted. The forest rangers are making terrific sounds. The tormentor of enemies, endowed with all virtues, by virtue of the boon given by Indra extended hospitality to the Vanara army. I think they are crossing the river Gomathi now."

40019669.author: पदार्थः
40019669.content: भरद्वाजप्रसादेन grace of Bharadwaja, सदाफलान् fruits all through, कुसुमितान् flowers, मधुस्रवान् shedding sweet juice, मत्तभ्रमरनादितान् noisy by the noisy bees, वृक्षान् trees, प्राप्य seen, प्रहृष्टानाम् very delighted, वनौकसाम् forest rangers, भीमः terrific, निःस्वनः sounds, श्रूयते is heard, परन्तप tormentor of enemies, तस्य his, एषः in that way, वरः boon, वासवेन, दत्तः given by Indra, ससैन्यस्य that army, तव your, सर्वगुणान्वितम् endowed with all virtues, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, कृतम् done, सा they, वानरसेना Vanara army, गोमतींनदीम् Gomathi, तरति crossing, मन्ये I think

40019669.author: Translation
40019669.content: "By the grace of Bharadwaja, all the trees have fruits shedding sweet juice, and in bloom, the Vanaras are very delighted. The forest rangers are making terrific sounds. The tormentor of enemies, endowed with all virtues, by virtue of the boon given by Indra extended hospitality to the Vanara army. I think they are crossing the river Gomathi now."

40019670.author: पदार्थः
40019670.content: सालवनंप्रति Sala forest, समुद्भूतम् started, रजोवर्षम् rain of dust, पश्य see, प्लवङ्गमाः Vanaras, रम्यम् beautiful, सालवनम् Sala grove, लोलयन्ति shaking, मन्ये I think

40019670.author: Translation
40019670.content: "See the rain of dust started at Sala Forest. Vanaras are shaking the beautiful Sala grove, I think."

40019671.author: पदार्थः
40019671.content: चन्द्रसन्निभम् resembling the moon, तत् that, एतत् this, विमानम् aerial car, दूरात् at a distance, दृश्यते is seen, दिव्यम् wonderful, पुष्पकंविमानम् Pushpaka, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, मनसा by his mind, निर्मितम् created

40019671.author: Translation
40019671.content: Pushpaka is seen at a distance, resembling the moon. This wonderful Pushpaka has been created through Brahma's mind.

40019672.author: पदार्थः
40019672.content: रावणम् Ravana, बान्दवैःसार्थम् relatives, हत्वा killed, महात्मना great, लब्दम् got, तरुणादित्यसङ्काशम् shines like the rising sun brightly, रामवाहनम् Rama's vehicle, एतत् this, दिव्यम् amazing, मनोजवम् speeds at mind thought, विमानम् aerial car, प्रसादेन by the grace, धनदस्य to Kubera

40019672.author: Translation
40019672.content: "Rama's vehicle is amazing, and he got it by killing Ravana and his relatives. It shines brightly like the rising sun, and it speeds at the thought of mind. Kubera got this aerial car by Brahma's grace."

40019673.author: पदार्थः
40019673.content: वीरौ heroes, भ्रातरौ brothers, वैदेह्यासह with Vaidehi, राघवौ Raghavas, महातेजाः highly energetic, सुग्रीवश्च Sugriva, राक्षसः Rakshasa, विभीषणश्च Vibheeshana too, एतस्मिन् all in that

40019673.author: Translation
40019673.content: "Heroic Raghava brothers are there with Vaidehi, that highly energetic Sugriva and Rakshasa Vibheeshana also."

40019674.author: पदार्थः
40019674.content: तः then, अयम् this, रामःSri Rama, इति there, कीर्तिते uttered, स्त्रीबालयुववृद्धानाम् women, young, youth and aged, हर्षसमुद्भूतः fantastic expression of joy, निःस्वनःsky, दिवम् sky, अस्पृशत् indistinct

40019674.author: Translation
40019674.content: Then when "Sri Rama is here" was uttered a fantastic expression of joy of the women, young, youth and aged was heard, which reached the heaven.

40019675.author: पदार्थः
40019675.content: रथकुञ्जरवाजिभ्यः chariots, elephants and horses, अवतीर्य got down, महीम् on ground, गताः went, तेनराः those people, विमानस्थम् in the Pushpaka, तम् them, अम्बरे sky, सोममिव like moon, ददृशुः saw

40019675.author: Translation
40019675.content: Those people on the chariots, elephants and horses got down and saw them on the moon like Pushpaka.

40019676.author: पदार्थः
40019676.content: प्राञ्जलिः salutations, प्रहृष्टः highly rejoiced, भरतः Bharata, राघवोन्मुखः Raghava's face, भूत्वा standing, यथार्हेण as he ought to, स्वागतेन in himself, रामम् Sri Rama, अपूजयत् worshipped

40019676.author: Translation
40019676.content: Highly rejoiced, Bharata offered salutations standing as he ought to within himself and worshiped Sri Rama from a distance.

40019677.author: पदार्थः
40019677.content: मनसा in his mind, ब्रह्मणा Brahmana, सृष्टे created, विमाने aerial car, पृथुदीर्घाक्षः broad eyed, भरताग्रजः Bharata's elder brother, अपरः another, वज्रपाणिरिव like Indra, रराज shone

40019677.author: Translation
40019677.content: Sri Rama, elder brother of Bharata shone in the aerial car created by Brahma like another Indra.

40019678.author: पदार्थः
40019678.content: ततः then, भरतः Bharata, विमानाग्रगतम् peak of Pushpaka, मेरुस्थम् like Meru mountain, भास्करंयथा like the sun, रामम् Sri Rama, तदा then, प्रणतः salutations with joined palms, ववन्दे offered

40019678.author: Translation
40019678.content: Then Bharata offered salutations with joined palms to Sri Rama seated in the peak of Pushpaka like saluting Sun from the mountain Meru.

40019679.author: पदार्थः
40019679.content: ततः then, अनुत्तमम् excellent, हंसयुक्तम् with pictures of swan, महावेगम् high speed, तत् that विमानम् aerial car, रामाभ्यनुज्ञातम् Rama's permission, महीतले on the ground, निपपात came down

40019679.author: Translation
40019679.content: Then that excellent Pushpaka which had pictures of swans on it came down to the ground with Rama's permission.

40019680.author: पदार्थः
40019680.content: ततविमानम् that Pushpaka, आरोपितः lifted on, सत्यविक्रमः unfailing valour, भरतः Bharata, रामम् Rama, आसाद्य reached, पुनरेव once again, अभ्यवादयत् greeted

40019680.author: Translation
40019680.content: Bharata of unfailing valour duly permitted to ascend Pushpaka by Sri Rama, reached Rama and once again offered salutations to Rama.

40019681.author: पदार्थः
40019681.content: काकुत्स्थः Kakuthsa, चिराय after long, अक्षिपथम् who came in his sight, गतम् arrived at, तम् him, भरतम् Bharata, समुत्थाप्य lifting up, अङ्कम् thigh, आरोप्य lifted to, मुदितःhappily, परिषस्वजे embraced

40019681.author: Translation
40019681.content: Kakuthsa Rama happily lifting up Bharata, who came into his sight after long, on to his thigh embraced him.

40019682.author: पदार्थः
40019682.content: ततः then, परन्तपः tormentor of enemies, भरतः Bharata, प्रीतः lovingly, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, वैदेहीं च and Vaidehi, आसाद्य approached, अथ and then, अभ्यवादयत् greeted, नाम name, अब्रवीत् च announced

40019682.author: Translation
40019682.content: Then the tormentor of enemies, Bharata approached Lakshmana and then greeted Vaidehi and announced his name.

40019683.author: पदार्थः
40019683.content: अथ and then, केकयीपुत्रः Kaikeyi's son, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavantha, अङ्गदम् Angada, मैन्दम् Mainda, द्विविदंचैव and Dwivivida, नीलम् Nila, ऋषभम् Rshaba, परषस्वजे embraced

40019683.author: Translation
40019683.content: Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi thereafter embraced Sugriva, Jambavantha, Angada, Mainda, Dwivivida, Nila and Rshaba.

40019684.author: पदार्थः
40019684.content: सुषेणं च Sushena, नलंचैव Nala, गवाक्षम् Gavaksha, गन्धमादनम् Gandhamadana, शरभम् Sarabha, पनसंचैव Panasa, परितः all around, परिषस्वजे embraced

40019684.author: Translation
40019684.content: He embraced Sushena, Nala, Gavaksha, Gandhamadana, Sarabha, Panasa who were around.

40019685.author: पदार्थः
40019685.content: तदा then, कामरूपिणः who can take any form at will, तेवानराः those Vanaras, मानुषंरूपम् in human form, कृत्वा doing, प्रहृष्टाः delighted, भरतम् Bharata, कुशलम् welfare, पर्यपृच्छन् inquired

40019685.author: Translation
40019685.content: Then he inquired about the welfare of those Vanaras who can take any form at will, who were in human form and was delighted.

40019686.author: पदार्थः
40019686.content: अथ and then, महातेजाः highly brilliant, धर्मिणाम् among the righteous, वरः foremost, राजपुत्रः prince, भरतः Bharata, वानरर्षभम् bull among Vanaras, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, परिष्वज्य, embraced, अब्रवीत् and spoke

40019686.author: Translation
40019686.content: And thereafter highly brilliant, foremost among the righteous, prince Bharata embraced Sugriva, the bull among Vanaras and spoke.

40019687.author: पदार्थः
40019687.content: सुग्रीव Sugriva, त्वम् you, अस्माकम् our, चतुर्णाम् fourth, पञ्चमः fifth, भ्राता brother, सौहार्दात् affectionately, मित्रम् friend, जायते born, अपकारः maleficence, अरिलक्षणम् sign of an enemy

40019687.author: Translation
40019687.content: "Sugriva, you are the fifth brother to four of us and should have been born like that" said Bharata. One who helps becomes friend and maleficence is a sign of an enemy.

40019688.author: पदार्थः
40019688.content: अथ and then, भरतः Bharata, विभीषणं च Vibheeshana, सान्त्ववाक्यम् good word, अब्रवीत् spoke, दिष्ट्या luckily, सहायेन help, त्वया by you, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, कर्म task, कृतम् was done

40019688.author: Translation
40019688.content: And then Bharata spoke this good word. "Luckily with your help, the very difficult task was done."

40019689.author: पदार्थः
40019689.content: तदा then, वीरः hero, शत्रुघ्नश्च Shatrughna also, सलक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana also, रामम् Rama, अभिवाद्य greeted, सीतायाः and Sita, चरणौ feet, विनयात् obediently, अभ्यवादयत् worshipped

40019689.author: Translation
40019689.content: Then hero Shatrughna and Lakshmana also greeted Rama and then worshipped Sita also.

40019690.author: पदार्थः
40019690.content: रामः Rama, विवर्णाम् pale, शोककर्शिताम् emaciated by grief, मातरम् mother, आसाद्य reached, प्रणतः offered salutations, मातुः to mother, मनः in mind, प्रहर्षयन् delighted, पादौ feet, जग्राह clasped

40019690.author: Translation
40019690.content: Rama reached his mother who was pale and emaciated in grief and offered salutations clasping her feet in obedience and was delighted in his mind.

40019691.author: पदार्थः
40019691.content: सः he, सुमित्रां च Sumitra also, यशस्विनीम् illustrious, कैकेयीं च Kaikeyi also, अभिवाद्य greeted, सर्वाः all, मात्रूश्च mothers, ततः then, पुरोहितम् priests, उपागमत् had come

40019691.author: Translation
40019691.content: Then he greeted Sumitra, and illustrious Kaikeyi also and then all the mothers and the priests who had come.

40019692.author: पदार्थः
40019692.content: महाबाहो mightyarmed, कौसल्यानन्दवर्धन enhancer of Kausalya's joy, ते you, स्वागतम् welcome, सर्वे all, नागराः people of the city, प्राञ्जलयः with folded palms, अब्रुवन् spoke

40019692.author: Translation
40019692.content: "Welcome to you mighty armed Rama, enhancer of Kausalya's joy" saying so citizens of the city spoke with folded hand s greeting Rama.

40019693.author: पदार्थः
40019693.content: नागरैः citizens, प्रगृहीतानि taking up, तानि they, अञ्जलिसहस्राणि thousands greeting with folded palms, भरताग्रजः elder brother of Bharata, व्याकोचानि displayed, पद्मानीव like lotus buds, ददर्श seemed

40019693.author: Translation
40019693.content: The citizens in thousands greeting Rama, elder brother of Bharata lifting up their hand s with folded palms seemed like lotus buds.

40019694.author: पदार्थः
40019694.content: धर्मवित् knower of dharma, भरतः Bharata, रामस्य Rama's, ते you, पादुके sandals, गृहीत्वा taking, स्वयम् himself, नरेन्द्रस्य king's, चरणाभ्याम् to both feet, योजयामास placed

40019694.author: Translation
40019694.content: Taking the sandals given to Bharata, the knower of dharma put on the sandals on Rama's feet by himself.

40019695.author: पदार्थः
40019695.content: सःभरतः he, Bharata, कृताञ्जलिः greeting with folded palms, तदा then, रामम् to Rama, अब्रवीच्च spoke, न्यासम् held in trust, ते to you, सकलम् everything, एतत् this, राज्यम् kingdom, मया by me, निर्यातितम् returned

40019695.author: Translation
40019695.content: Bharata then greeted Rama with folded palms, spoke saying, "this kingdom and everything held in trust by me is returned to you."

40019696.author: पदार्थः
40019696.content: अद्य today, मे I, जन्म life, कृतार्थम् fulfilled, मनोरथः च my wish, सम्वृत्तः completed, यत् that, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, पुनः again, आगतम् have returned, त्वाम् you, राजानम् kingdom, पश्यामि seeing

40019696.author: Translation
40019696.content: Today my life is fulfilled, my wish is completed. I am seeing you returned to Ayodhya again as king of this kingdom.

40019697.author: पदार्थः
40019697.content: भवान् you, कोशम् treasury, कोष्ठागारम् granary, गृहम् palaces, बलम् army, अवेक्षताम् may see, भवतः by your, तेजसा brilliance, मया by me, सर्वम् all, दशगुणम् tenfold, कृतम् done

40019697.author: Translation
40019697.content: You may review your treasury, granary, palaces, army. Everything has increased tenfold by me by virtue of your brilliance.

40019698.author: पदार्थः
40019698.content: तथा so also, ब्रुवाणम् spoke, भ्रातृवत्सलम् lover of brother, तंभरतम् that Bharata, दृष्टवा seeing, वानराः Vanaras, बाष्पम् tears, मुमुचुः shed, राक्षसः Rakshasa, विभीषणं च Vibheeshana also

40019698.author: Translation
40019698.content: Seeing Bharata, the lover of his brother, who spoke like that, the Vanaras, Rakshasas, and Vibheeshana shed tears.

40019699.author: पदार्थः
40019699.content: ततः then, राघवः Raghava, प्रहर्षात् rejoiced, भरतम् Bharata, अङ्कम् thigh, आरोप्य lifted up, ससैन्यः that army, भरताश्रमम् from Bharata's hermitage, ययौ flew

40019699.author: Translation
40019699.content: Then rejoiced Raghava took Bharata on his lap and flew to Bharata's hermitage with the army.

40019700.author: पदार्थः
40019700.content: तदा then, राघवः Raghava, भरताश्रमम् Bharata's hermitage, आसाद्य alighted, ससैन्यः that army, विमानाग्रात् top of Pushpaka, अवतीर्य landed, महीतले on ground, अवतस्थे stood

40019700.author: Translation
40019700.content: Raghava alighted from the top of the Pushpaka on reaching the hermitage of Bharata and stood on ground.

40019701.author: पदार्थः
40019701.content: तदा then, रामः Rama, अनुत्तमम् best, तत् that, विमानम् Pushpaka, अब्रवीत् told, देवम् god, वैश्रवणम् Vysravana, वह there अनुजानामि permit, गम्यताम् to go

40019701.author: Translation
40019701.content: Then Rama told Pushpaka that he was permitted to go to God Vysravana.

40019702.author: पदार्थः
40019702.content: ततः that, रामाभ्यनुज्ञातम् Rama's permission, अनुत्तमम् the best, तत् विमानम् that aerial car, धनदालयम् उद्धिश्य rose up to Kubera, उत्तरांदिशम् in the northern direction, जगाम went

40019702.author: Translation
40019702.content: That aerial car duly permitted by Rama rose up to go to Kubera and set out in the northern direction and flew.

40019703.author: पदार्थः
40019703.content: रक्षसा Rakshasa, सम्गृहीतम् received, दिव्यम् wonderful, पुष्पकंविमानम् Pushpaka aerial car, रामवाक्यप्रचोदितम् impelled by Rama's order, वेगात् speedily, धनदम् to Kubera, आगमत् went

40019703.author: Translation
40019703.content: That wonderful Pushpaka received from Rakshasa impelled by Rama's order speedily went to Kubera.
